decisions: Minutes from the February 19, 2025 board meeting approved as amended.
Revised 15-day invoicing policy to be enforced starting April 1, 2025; CFO to oversee implementation.

Aiyana Park to prepare and deliver a formal expansion proposal to Polestar Industries by April 16, 2025, targeting a revised annual contract value of $1.85 million; Margaret Holvan to conduct preliminary outreach to Polestar Industries CEO by April 2, 2025.
Operational restructuring of regional teams approved in principle; transition and communication plan due April 9, 2025; implementation to begin no earlier than May 1, 2025.
Technology evaluation committee formed to assess Nexovate Pro and ClarityOps Suite; vendor recommendation due April 25, 2025; budget ceiling of $240,000 pre-approved.
Aiyana Park to draft an updated remote work policy for review at the April board meeting; leadership attendance at Consulting Forward 2025 (May 8–9, Chicago) approved.
